name: Hangzhou SF Intra-city Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou SF Intra-city Industrial Co., Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the intra-city on-demand delivery services. It provides intra-city delivery for merchants and consumers and last-mile delivery mainly for logistics companies. The company was founded on June 21, 2019 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
